name: Other PIT deductions: a voluntary pension contribution comes off the assessable income
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: A full month on 30,000,000, all 22 working days paid; the person put 1,000,000 into a voluntary pension fund this month, typed into the run as PIT_VOLUNTARY_PENSION. It is not pay: no line, nothing in gross or net — it only comes off the assessable income.
PIT: first bracket 10,000,000 x 5% = 500,000; second bracket 350,000 x 10% = 35,000; total 535,000. Without the contribution it would be 11,350,000 assessable and 635,000 tax.
